name: Question 4
problem:
Change the order of integration in the integral

$$
{\int }_{0}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡3}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{{e}^{y}-1}f(x,y,z)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}y.
$$

so that it is integrated first with respect to $y,$ then $x,$ and then $z.$
